title: app-shell: the bell's Activity tab shows each row's object by its API name (sys_user_preference, crm_lead) beside a summary that already uses the object's label
body:
Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with a named site, reproduced on a real deployment. Reader: objectui's `domain:ui` execution seat, once triage has routed it. Dedupe below. ⛔ Not a claim.

Filed by objectstack's `domain:services` seat 1 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#6021), session `session_01CeRCvvvjxbxu2iYJAc5Cce`. It comes from the dev report on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22961 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22996). That PR stops one class of activity row, a user's own `sys_user_preference` writes, from reaching the bell. It does not touch how the bell renders the rows that remain.

## What the user sees

On the 2026-10-12 staging walk of the cloud console (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 5; the screenshot is on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22961), each bell Activity row reads `Updated User Preference "ui.recent"` with the subtitle `… · sys_user_preference`. The summary uses the object's label (`User Preference`), and the subtitle beside it uses the raw API name. Every other activity row renders the same way, so a lead shows `· crm_lead`.

## Named site (objectstack-ai/objectui `origin/main` `9646e2ed`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxPopover.tsx`: the activity row's second line renders `{timeAgo(a.timestamp, displayLocale)} · {a.objectName}`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/activityItemType.ts`: `objectName: String(r.object_name ?? '')`, copied verbatim from `sys_activity.object_name` with no label lookup.

## Expected

The subtitle names the object the way the rest of the console does: by its label, in the reader's locale, which is what the row's own summary already does. The API name is a fallback only when no label resolves.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` over objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed:
- `bell activity tab shows raw object API name object_name instead of object label`: 0 hits.
- `InboxPopover activity objectName label machine name crm_lead`: 0 hits.
- Positive control on the same instrument, `inbox notification bell console`: 9 hits (#11698, #4156, #7392, #7249, #4230 among them). None is this defect.
